facts.business: Manufacturing and export of specialty polyester and nylon yarns, covered yarns, high tenacity yarns, and sewing threads.

auditor.name: CNK & Associates LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified audit opinion on consolidated audited financial statements for the year ended March 31, 2026, relating to the sale by the Company of 11 Non-Cumulative Redeemable Preference Shares held in its wholly owned subsidiary, Sarla Flex Inc. (United States of America), for a consideration of USD 1,21,000, resulting in a loss of Rs 7,713.26 lakhs which has been fully recognised as an Exceptional Item in the financial statements for the year ended March 31, 2026.

key_risks: Disruption from Emerging Material Technologies: Advancements in alternative materials could challenge existing product relevance and require continuous adaptation.
